keyLimits.en: 5 local numbers, 250 minutes, 25 SMS included; call & text tracking, recording, routing, transcription, automation rules.
Adds 1,000 form submissions, form tracking & attribution, custom form builder, multi-touch CPL reporting.
10,000 analysis/transcription minutes; call summaries, sentiment analysis, conversation trends, automatic conversion tagging, coaching tools.
Combines all features and maximum included usage from lower tiers.

addOns.en: AI Voice Assistant from $95/month, requiring the $55 Lead Tracking add-on minimum; includes 50 calls, then $1/call.

cautions.en: Usage overages billed separately: local minutes $0.05-0.06 each, extra local numbers $3 each, toll-free numbers $5 each, SMS $0.03 each, form submissions $0.02 each.

capabilities.en: Call tracking with dynamic number insertion to attribute inbound calls to marketing sources.
Call recording, transcription and AI-driven sentiment/conversation analysis on higher tiers.
Form tracking and multi-touch conversion attribution on the Complete plans.
Public API with tiered pricing (free up to 1,500 calls/month, then paid tiers up to 300,000 calls).

limitations.en: Entry plan excludes form tracking and conversation-intelligence features, which require upgrading.
Included usage (minutes, numbers, SMS) is modest and overage fees apply quickly beyond the base allotment.

reason.en: Overlaps for marketing attribution and conversion analytics, though behavior-tracking rather than call-based.
